scene: An 86-year-old woman of mixed heritage with naturally aged face and hands sits at a table studying two simple unlettered apartment floor plans beside her own walking stick. She traces the short route between a bedroom and bathroom on one plan while considering a small coin purse beside the other. A simple key ring nearby. Exactly one person. Sparse room, no estate agent, no finished new apartment or promise of a move. Keep floor-plan marks generic and unreadable. Keep meaningful people and objects fully inside a generous clear outer margin on all four sides; no furniture, plant, prop or wall ends against an image boundary. Peripheral details taper naturally into irregular broken drawn ends and clean pale paper; no rectangular cut-off or uniform blur. No readable text, labels or logos. Wide balanced scene grouped in the middle, upper area, with calm space around it.
